preferences.models.embeddingModelDescrip: Vectorizes CVs, job ads and criteria for ranking — app-wide, not per job. Switching re-embeds everything: each job's candidates are cleared, so re-import its CV folder afterwards (the folders are kept).
preferences.models.switchDescription: Vectors are model-specific: switching empties every job's candidates — re-import each job's CV folder afterwards (the CV directories are kept). The job ads and criteria are re-embedded automatically with the new model. Learned feedback is stored per model — this model starts fresh, and your current model's feedback is restored when you switch back.
